headline: Healthy core business performance

highlights: Q 2F Y2 7 performance : IKS revenue came at ₹1,592.5 crore, up 103.9% YoY/ 78.2% QoQ (US$169mn, up 74.2% QoQ/87.3% YoY).

Investment Rationale: • Healthy core growth, customer traction and cross-sell opportunities: The legacy IKS business (IKS+Aquity) delivered 12% + US$ YoY growth to US$101mn, with management expecting it to sustain above - industry growth .
While for TruBridge, FY27 will remain a year of integration & stabilisation, with no significant growth expected till FY28.

It’s US$200 mn System of Action (SOA) component is expected to edge toward 10-12% growth by end of FY28/early FY29 while ~US$100mn System of Record (EHR) business is intended to stay relatively flat through FY28 & FY29.
valuation: Rating and Target Price : We maintain our BUY rating for IKS and value it at 32x FY28E EPS, for a target price of ₹ 2,050 .

The 3 features (denial prediction, coding, clinical productivity tools) are targeted to go live by Q1 FY28. • Management Outlook : − Legacy IKS (IKS+Aquity) : expected to sustain growth above the industry benchmark of 12%.

On the margins front, it aspires to restore margins of both businesses to early-to-mid-30s by FY30 and achieve near-zero net leverage by FY30 and remains optimistic about the true north target of ₹3,000 crore EBITDA by FY30. • TruBridge integration: Q2 saw 82 days of integration with TruBridge.
watch: Management identified operating-model optimisation, greater global delivery and technology-led productivity, and SG&A rationalisation as key synergy levers, with benefits expected from the second half of Q3 onwards.
Management sees access to 3.5 –4x the initially envisaged 5 mn patient records from TruBridge as a key strategic asset to build proprietary context layers, knowledge graphs and AI models.
